verdict.rationale: Superset is a coding-agent orchestration workspace. It runs external CLI agents such as Claude Code and Codex in isolated worktrees, but the evidence never shows the product itself analyzing user data to produce AI-generated insights or suggestions. Agent-created reports and diff review are adjacent features delivered by third-party agents, not a built-in data-insights capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
